title: May 2015 General Election (Beta — Alternative History)
description: Beta scenario based on the May 2015 UK general election. In this alternative-history variant the simulation diverges from the actual result; the specific narrative divergence is TBD. The simulation begins in August 2015 with players entering a newly-formed Parliament. This scenario is in active development: constituency data, budget baselines, factions, and local council figures all require real data before it can be used in production.
